a: Later @layer declarations can override earlier ones by default order rules.
!important overrides normal specificity but harms maintainability.
isolation: isolate creates a new stacking context.
contain optimizes rendering by limiting a subtree's impact.
content-visibility can skip rendering offscreen content.
will-change hints optimizers; overuse wastes memory.
font-display controls how fonts render while loading.
image-rendering affects scaling quality for pixel art vs photos.
scroll-margin offsets scroll snap and scroll-into-view targets.
overscroll-behavior controls scroll chaining to parent containers.
